mechanisms.decisive_claim: In any fixed graph and fixed recolouring model with disjoint repeated-colour classes, two switches using distinct output edges and disjoint colour classes are jointly rainbow-C7 whenever the base state and both singleton states are rainbow-C7.
would_close: joint legality from typed singleton legality
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate C7 colour repetitions by colour class; kill if a joint-only bad cycle exists despite both singleton states passing.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: There exists an n=16 exact-threshold extension of the locked n=14 graph, obtained by adding B vertices w,u and fifteen incident edges without deleting an old edge, in which natural switches b-x1 to w-x1 and b-x2 to u-x2 are singleton-legal, jointly legal, and expose distinct outputs wz and uz.
mechanisms.kill_test: Exhaust the symmetric subfamily containing w-X and u-X and test threshold, rainbow C7, L4(2), reserves, singleton and joint states.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: If the pure fifteen-edge addition model has no witness, one old-edge deletion and sixteen new incident edges suffice to produce the same two-output legal-switch witness while preserving A=N[v], threshold density, L4(2), and the base colouring.
mechanisms.kill_test: Search edge deletions only after extracting the exact C7 obstruction cores of the addition model; reject any candidate failing a named predicate.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Every failed natural switch in the two-new-vertex model contains a bad C7 whose new-edge trace meets a bounded obstruction-core list independent of the untouched old graph.
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate minimal new-edge traces of bad C7s for w-x1/c-y1 and u-x2/c-y2; kill if unboundedly many old-dependent traces are essential.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The exact Boolean clauses for threshold degree, base rainbow legality, two singleton switches, joint legality and two distinct canonical outputs are jointly satisfiable in the two-new-vertex one-edge-exchange model.
mechanisms.kill_test: Encode every bad C7 as a forbidden edge conjunction and replay a satisfying assignment as a labelled graph.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Whenever two individually legal natural switches change bases bc to cw and cu and wz,uz lie in the respective new reserves but outside the old reserve, the augmented demand-output graph has matching rank at least two.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute old and new canonical reserves and run exact matching; kill if distinct named outputs nevertheless refer to one edge or one demand.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: A first two-output witness has output codegree one and no indispensable old edge is used by both switch certificates.
mechanisms.kill_test: Extract all bad-cycle avoidance and recolouring resources for the two switches; kill if distinct outputs hide a shared capacity-one resource.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: In every scalable hard-branch extension, at most O(1) legal switch certificates use any one external output or exceptional endpoint.
mechanisms.kill_test: Blow up the first exact witness while retaining threshold and hard predicates; kill if output codegree grows with the locked class.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Adding two distinct legal output arcs for two different locked demands reduces the maximum Hall deficiency of the four-demand K(4,2) circuit from two to zero.
would_close: two local outputs saturate the locked cut
mechanisms.kill_test: Enumerate every demand cut and exact matching after adding the two arcs.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: If every inclusion-minimal deficient cut receives delta(T) distinct compatible external outputs owned inside T, then the augmented typed carrier graph satisfies all Hall cuts.
mechanisms.kill_test: Test arbitrary finite carrier graphs and prove or refute the submodular uncrossing step with occupied outputs retained.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Deleting one old edge from each minimal bad-C7 obstruction core can preserve L4(2) while making both natural switches legal at exact threshold after replacement by new incident edges.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compute a minimum hitting set of bad-cycle cores and exactly replay all L4 endpoint/deletion cases after each edge exchange.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Distinct output edges and distinct colour owners are sufficient compatibility resources for natural fixed-graph recolouring switches; no additional capacity-one witness resource is consumed.
mechanisms.kill_test: Compare singleton and joint recolourings and identify whether legality is a static property rather than a consumable witness.
